calculation.description: Cross-sectional medium-term momentum scaled by trailing 20-session realized volatility. The complete signal is lagged one session; higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted trend.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates on the 10-session forward horizon. Positive in 2020-22 (IC 0.048239, ICIR 0.153751), 2023-25 (0.052313, 0.158155), and 2028 (0.082598, 0.229220), but negative in 2026-27 (-0.047350, -0.144648), indicating regime dependence. Recent 252 dates remain strong (IC 0.079226, ICIR 0.220973). Interpret conservatively and use with defensive/regime controls.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; dates require at least 8 valid instruments; no future data used.
